table.name: TLGNR_PURCHASINGORG_BS
table.description: Represents a Purchasing Organisation from SAP. In SAP, called EKORG.

column.name: PURCHASINGORG_CD
column.description: PK. The purchasing organisation code as known in SAP (EKORG), e.g.: FR01, BG01

column.name: PURCHASINGORG_NAME
column.description: Full name of the purchasing organisation which may be displayed in the application. Normally, only the code (purchasingorg_cd) is used and displayed however.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
